provenance: Original AI-generated imagery created for the Forma studio demo. These illustrate fictional architecture and furniture projects.
postprocessing: Format conversion from tool PNG outputs to JPEG quality 90 via macOS sips; no content edits.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: wide editorial architecture photograph for a contemporary design studio portfolio website
Primary request: Casa Luma, a warm minimalist Mediterranean living room with a sculptural curved ivory sofa, low travertine coffee table and large sunny arched opening.
Scene/backdrop: beautifully detailed pale warm lime-plaster walls, honed travertine floor, Mediterranean courtyard glimpse through the arch, no clutter.
Style/medium: exceptionally convincing high-end architectural photography, natural fine grain, carefully observed material texture, sophisticated magazine art direction.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2, wide room view at human eye level, architectural verticals straight, balanced sculptural furniture and arch composition, generous spatial depth.
Lighting/mood: clear late-afternoon Mediterranean daylight, warm sun rays and architectural shadow, serene and tactile.
Color palette: warm ivory, sand, honey and muted olive foliage.
Constraints: No people, no writing, no logo, no watermark, no collage. A complete full-frame photograph.
assets.alt: Sunlit Mediterranean living room with curved ivory seating, a travertine coffee table, and an arched courtyard opening.

assets.prompt:

Color palette: saturated cobalt blue focal point, pale warm grey concrete, silver chrome.
Constraints: No people, no writing, no logo, no watermark, no collage. A complete full-frame photograph.
assets.alt: Sculptural cobalt blue lounge chair and reflective chrome side table in a pale concrete studio.
